questions.why: 況且 adds a second, practical reason to "students don't need designer things": a small bag cannot hold the pile of books she carries, and she agrees (說得也是) and keeps the big old one. Price and looks are never mentioned, and he offers no gift.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳每天來上課都穿得這麼講究，不累嗎？
lines.simplified: 你每天来上课都穿得这么讲究，不累吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān lái shàngkè dōu chuān de zhème jiǎngjiù, bú lèi ma?
lines.english: You dress so carefully for class every day. Isn't it tiring?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不會啊。我以前在服裝公司當主管，天天都要穿得很正式。現在穿慣了，穿得太輕鬆反而不自在。

lines.pinyin: Bú huì a. Wǒ yǐqián zài fúzhuāng gōngsī dāng zhǔguǎn, tiāntiān dōu yào chuān de hěn zhèngshì. Xiànzài chuān guàn le, chuān de tài qīngsōng fǎn'ér bú zìzài.
lines.english: Not at all. I used to be a manager at a clothing company and had to dress formally every day. Now I'm used to it; dressing too casually actually makes me uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 難怪妳的品味這麼好。

lines.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ de pǐnwèi zhème hǎo.
lines.english: No wonder you have such good taste.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 女的为什么每天都穿得很讲究？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme měi tiān dōu chuān de hěn jiǎngjiù?
prompt.english: Why does the woman dress so carefully every day?

choices.speaker: N

choices.simplified: 下课以后还要去公司上班
choices.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu hái yào qù gōngsī shàngbān.
choices.english: She still goes to work after class.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xuéxiào yào dàjiā chuān de zhèngshì.
choices.english: The school wants everyone to dress formally.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 以前的工作讓她習慣了
choices.simplified: 以前的工作让她习惯了
choices.pinyin: Yǐqián de gōngzuò ràng tā xíguàn le.
choices.english: Her old job got her used to it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得正式的衣服最舒適
choices.simplified: 她觉得正式的衣服最舒适
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde zhèngshì de yīfú zuì shūshì.
choices.english: She finds formal clothes the most comfortable.

questions.why: 穿慣了: years of dressing formally as a manager made it a habit, so casual clothes now feel wrong. The job is in the past (以前), the formal rule was her company's, not the school's, and she speaks of habit, not comfort.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳的筆記本怎麼寫得滿滿的？老師說的每一句話妳都記下來了？
lines.simplified: 你的笔记本怎么写得满满的？老师说的每一句话你都记下来了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de bǐjìběn zěnme xiě de mǎnmǎn de? Lǎoshī shuō de měi yí jù huà nǐ dōu jì xiàlái le?
lines.english: Why is your notebook so full? Did you write down every sentence the teacher said?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 以前是這樣。後來一個高三的同學教我只寫重點，我花了一個多月才把這個習慣改過來。這本是高一的。
lines.simplified: 以前是这样。后来一个高三的同学教我只写重点，我花了一个多月才把这个习惯改过来。这本是高一的。
lines.pinyin: Yǐqián shì zhèyàng. Hòulái yí ge gāo sān de tóngxué jiāo wǒ zhǐ xiě zhòngdiǎn, wǒ huā le yí ge duō yuè cái bǎ zhège xíguàn gǎi guòlái. Zhè běn shì gāo yī de.
lines.english: I used to. Then a third-year classmate taught me to write only the key points, and it took me over a month to break that habit. This one is from my first year of high school.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那這一堆舊筆記還留著做什麼？
lines.simplified: 那这一堆旧笔记还留着做什么？
lines.pinyin: Nà zhè yì duī jiù bǐjì hái liúzhe zuò shénme?
lines.english: Then why keep this pile of old notes?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下個月的考試也考高一的內容，複習的時候用得著。考完以後，我再送給學校的新生。
lines.simplified: 下个月的考试也考高一的内容，复习的时候用得着。考完以后，我再送给学校的新生。
lines.pinyin: Xià ge yuè de kǎoshì yě kǎo gāo yī de nèiróng, fùxí de shíhòu yòng de zháo. Kǎo wán yǐhòu, wǒ zài sòng gěi xuéxiào de xīnshēng.
lines.english: Next month's exam covers first-year material too, so they will be useful when I review. After the exam I'll give them to the school's new students.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的花了一個多月改過來的是什麼習慣？
prompt.simplified: 女的花了一个多月改过来的是什么习惯？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de huā le yí ge duō yuè gǎi guòlái de shì shénme xíguàn?
prompt.english: What habit did the woman spend over a month breaking?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǐ xiě lǎoshī shuō de zhòngdiǎn.
choices.english: Writing only the teacher's key points.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 把老師的話全部記下來
choices.simplified: 把老师的话全部记下来
choices.pinyin: Bǎ lǎoshī de huà quánbù jì xiàlái.
choices.english: Writing down everything the teacher says.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shàngkè zhǐ tīng, bù xiě bǐjì.
choices.english: Only listening in class, taking no notes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǎ bǐjì sòng gěi biérén.
choices.english: Giving her notes away.

questions.why: 改過來 is putting a wrong habit right: she used to write down every sentence (以前是這樣), and it took a month to change. Writing only key points is the new way, not the old habit, and giving notes away is her plan for later.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的打算怎麼處理那堆舊筆記？
prompt.simplified: 女的打算怎么处理那堆旧笔记？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de dǎsuàn zěnme chǔlǐ nà duī jiù bǐjì?
prompt.english: What does the woman plan to do with the pile of old notes?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kǎo wán shì jiù bǎ tāmen diū diào.
choices.english: Throw them away after the exam.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 現在就送給學校的新生
choices.simplified: 现在就送给学校的新生
choices.pinyin: Xiànzài jiù sòng gěi xuéxiào de xīnshēng.
choices.english: Give them to the new students now.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Sòng gěi jiāo tā de nà wèi tóngxué.
choices.english: Give them to the classmate who taught her.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先拿來複習，考完再送人
choices.simplified: 先拿来复习，考完再送人
choices.pinyin: Xiān ná lái fùxí, kǎo wán zài sòng rén.
choices.english: Use them to review first, give them away after.

questions.why: 複習的時候用得著 says the notes will still be of use for next month's exam, and 考完以後，我再送給…新生 gives the order: review first, give away afterwards. Giving them now skips the 考完以後, and the third-year classmate only taught her a method.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 爺爺，您在社區大學學電腦，學得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 爷爷，您在社区大学学电脑，学得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Yéye, nín zài shèqū dàxué xué diànnǎo, xué de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: Grandpa, how are your computer classes at the community college going?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 一開始我什麼都不懂，老師說的話就像外文一樣。後來老師帶我們慢慢做，我才明白過來，原來沒有那麼難。
lines.simplified: 一开始我什么都不懂，老师说的话就像外文一样。后来老师带我们慢慢做，我才明白过来，原来没有那么难。
lines.pinyin: Yì kāishǐ wǒ shénme dōu bù dǒng, lǎoshī shuō de huà jiù xiàng wàiwén yíyàng. Hòulái lǎoshī dài wǒmen mànmàn zuò, wǒ cái míngbái guòlái, yuánlái méiyǒu nàme nán.
lines.english: At first I understood nothing; what the teacher said sounded like a foreign language. Then the teacher led us through it slowly, and only then did it dawn on me that it isn't that hard.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那您現在會上網找資料了嗎？
lines.simplified: 那您现在会上网找资料了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nín xiànzài huì shàngwǎng zhǎo zīliào le ma?
lines.english: So can you look things up online now?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 會啊。昨天我想找一本很舊的書，書店都說沒有，結果我在網路上一下子就找著了。
lines.simplified: 会啊。昨天我想找一本很旧的书，书店都说没有，结果我在网路上一下子就找着了。
lines.pinyin: Huì a. Zuótiān wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yì běn hěn jiù de shū, shūdiàn dōu shuō méiyǒu, jiéguǒ wǒ zài wǎnglù shàng yíxiàzi jiù zhǎo zháo le.
lines.english: Yes. Yesterday I wanted an old book. The bookshops all said they didn't have it, but online I found it in no time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 爺爺剛開始學電腦的時候，覺得怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 爷爷刚开始学电脑的时候，觉得怎么样？

prompt.english: When Grandpa first started learning computers, how did he find it?

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: At first he could not follow at all.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī shàngkè dōu shuō Yīngwén.
choices.english: The teacher speaks English in class.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī yě jiāo dàjiā xué wàiwén.
choices.english: The teacher also teaches them a foreign language.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde diànnǎo méi nàme nán.
choices.english: He feels computers are not that hard.

questions.why: 一開始我什麼都不懂，老師說的話就像外文一樣: at first nothing the teacher said made sense to him. No foreign language is really spoken or taught, and "not that hard" is what he understood only later (後來……才明白過來), not how he felt at the start.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 爺爺為什麼說起找書的事？
prompt.simplified: 爷爷为什么说起找书的事？
prompt.pinyin: Yéye wèishénme shuō qǐ zhǎo shū de shì?
prompt.english: Why does Grandpa bring up looking for the book?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng qǐng nǚ de bāng tā zhǎo shū.
choices.english: He wants the woman to find the book for him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bàoyuàn shūdiàn de shū tài shǎo.
choices.english: He is complaining that bookshops have too few books.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng qǐng lǎoshī zài jiāo tā shàngwǎng.
choices.english: He wants the teacher to teach him the internet again.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想說明自己真的會上網了
choices.simplified: 想说明自己真的会上网了

choices.english: He is showing that he really can use the internet now.

questions.why: Asked 您現在會上網找資料了嗎, he answers 會啊 and gives the book as proof: the bookshops failed, but 在網路上一下子就找著了. He has already found it, the bookshops simply did not have that one book, and he needs no more lessons.

focus.en: found (V著了); why he says it

intro.english: Listen to a phone message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 親愛的家長，您好，這裡是大安國中。
lines.simplified: 亲爱的家长，您好，这里是大安国中。
lines.pinyin: Qīn'ài de jiāzhǎng, nín hǎo, zhèlǐ shì Dà'ān Guózhōng.
lines.english: Dear parents, hello. This is Da'an Junior High School.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 最近有不少家長告訴學校，孩子的考試太多了。為了減輕學生的負擔，從下學期開始，二年級每一科的期末測驗，都會以報告代替。
lines.simplified: 最近有不少家长告诉学校，孩子的考试太多了。为了减轻学生的负担，从下学期开始，二年级每一科的期末测验，都会以报告代替。
lines.pinyin: Zuìjìn yǒu bù shǎo jiāzhǎng gàosu xuéxiào, háizi de kǎoshì tài duō le. Wèile jiǎnqīng xuéshēng de fùdān, cóng xià xuéqí kāishǐ, èr niánjí měi yì kē de qímò cèyàn, dōu huì yǐ bàogào dàitì.
lines.english: Recently quite a few parents have told the school their children have too many tests. To lighten the students' load, from next term every end-of-term test in each Year 2 subject will be replaced by a report.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 學校希望把教學的重心放在培養學生解決問題的能力，尤其是跟同學合作的能力。
lines.simplified: 学校希望把教学的重心放在培养学生解决问题的能力，尤其是跟同学合作的能力。
lines.pinyin: Xuéxiào xīwàng bǎ jiàoxué de zhòngxīn fàng zài péiyǎng xuéshēng jiějué wèntí de nénglì, yóuqí shì gēn tóngxué hézuò de nénglì.
lines.english: The school wants teaching to focus on developing students' ability to solve problems, especially their ability to work with classmates.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 學期最後一個星期五，歡迎家長到學校，聽孩子們說明自己的學習成果。
lines.simplified: 学期最后一个星期五，欢迎家长到学校，听孩子们说明自己的学习成果。
lines.pinyin: Xuéqí zuìhòu yí ge xīngqíwǔ, huānyíng jiāzhǎng dào xuéxiào, tīng háizimen shuōmíng zìjǐ de xuéxí chéngguǒ.
lines.english: On the last Friday of term, parents are welcome to come to school and hear the children present what they have achieved.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 下学期开始，二年级的期末考有什么改变？
prompt.pinyin: Xià xuéqí kāishǐ, èr niánjí de qímòkǎo yǒu shénme gǎibiàn?
prompt.english: From next term, what changes about the Year 2 end-of-term exams?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 學生上課的時間會減少
choices.simplified: 学生上课的时间会减少
choices.pinyin: Xuéshēng shàngkè de shíjiān huì jiǎnshǎo.
choices.english: Students will have fewer class hours.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qímò bù kǎoshì, gǎi jiāo bàogào.
choices.english: No end-of-term exam; a report instead.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 期末測驗的題目會變少
choices.simplified: 期末测验的题目会变少
choices.pinyin: Qímò cèyàn de tímù huì biàn shǎo.
choices.english: End-of-term tests will have fewer questions.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 學期最後一天不必上課
choices.simplified: 学期最后一天不必上课
choices.pinyin: Xuéqí zuìhòu yì tiān búbì shàngkè.
choices.english: There is no class on the last day of term.

questions.why: 每一科的期末測驗，都會以報告代替: a report takes the place of the exam. What is cut is the students' load (減輕學生的負擔), not class time; the tests are replaced, not shortened; and the last Friday is a day for parents to visit, not a day off.

prompt.speaker: N

choices.simplified: 在大家面前说话的能力

choices.english: Speaking in front of others.

lines.english: Hello everyone. I am in charge of this round of training for new staff.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 很多剛出社會的新同事書念得很好，有的甚至是博士，可是在實際工作上，常常缺乏處理問題的經驗。
lines.simplified: 很多刚出社会的新同事书念得很好，有的甚至是博士，可是在实际工作上，常常缺乏处理问题的经验。
lines.pinyin: Hěn duō gāng chū shèhuì de xīn tóngshì shū niàn de hěn hǎo, yǒu de shènzhì shì bóshì, kěshì zài shíjì gōngzuò shàng, chángcháng quēfá chǔlǐ wèntí de jīngyàn.
lines.english: Many new colleagues who have just started working did very well at school, and some even have doctorates, but in real work they often lack experience in handling problems.

lines.speaker: M

text.traditional:
從今年起，一年級英文課改用新的分班制度：

text.traditional: 我舅舅今年五十歲，在一家電腦公司擔任主管已經十年了。在別人眼中，他的工作很有成就，可是他一直有一個沒有達成的理想：念博士。舅舅年輕的時候，家裡的錢不夠讓他升學，他高中畢業就開始工作，晚上再去念大學、研究所。去年，他終於被一所大學的博士班錄取了。很多人不明白，他的工作已經這麼好了，為什麼還要回學校，尤其是在這個年紀。舅舅說，工作了三十年，他發現社會變化得太快，碰到新的情況，如果只有過去的經驗，常常缺乏新的想法。博士班同學的水準都很高，他跟年輕的同學一起討論，吸收了很多新的東西，看事情的方式也大大地改變了。他說，學習不只是為了找工作，而是讓自己不管幾歲，都能為社會貢獻一份力量。

text.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu jīnnián wǔshí suì, zài yì jiā diànnǎo gōngsī dānrèn zhǔguǎn yǐjīng shí nián le. Zài biérén yǎn zhōng, tā de gōngzuò hěn yǒu chéngjiù, kěshì tā yìzhí yǒu yí ge méiyǒu dáchéng de lǐxiǎng: niàn bóshì. text.english: My uncle is fifty this year and has been a manager at a computer company for ten years. In other people's eyes his work is a real accomplishment, but he has always had one dream he has not achieved: doing a PhD. When he was young, his family did not have enough money for him to continue his studies; he started working after high school and studied for his first and master's degrees in the evenings. Last year he was finally admitted to a university's PhD programme. Many people don't understand why, with such a good job, he would go back to school, especially at his age. My uncle says that after thirty years of work he has found that society changes too fast; in new situations, if he has only past experience, he often lacks new ideas. The standard of his PhD classmates is high; he discusses things with the young classmates, has taken in a lot that is new, and the way he sees things has changed greatly. He says learning is not just for finding work; it lets you contribute your share to society whatever your age.

text.traditional: 我在高中教歷史已經十五年了。以前我教學的重心是讓學生記住年代和人名，因為升學考試就考這些。學生上課時一直寫筆記，回家再記答案，可是考完沒多久就忘記了。這樣的學習方式，對他們的未來似乎沒有什麼幫助。三年前，考試的制度改了，題目不再只考記得多少，而是要學生看了資料以後，說出自己的看法。剛開始，不少家長很不滿，覺得老師不教重點，孩子一定會吃虧。我也擔心自己教得不夠好。後來，我改用影片和老照片當教材，再利用網路工具讓學生幾個人一起找資料，討論社會上發生的事。現在學生不但記得住內容，還會主動問「為什麼」。上個學期，一位家長來學校告訴我，孩子回家會跟他討論新聞，他這才安心了。
text.simplified: 我在高中教历史已经十五年了。以前我教学的重心是让学生记住年代和人名，因为升学考试就考这些。学生上课时一直写笔记，回家再记答案，可是考完没多久就忘记了。这样的学习方式，对他们的未来似乎没有什么帮助。三年前，考试的制度改了，题目不再只考记得多少，而是要学生看了资料以后，说出自己的看法。刚开始，不少家长很不满，觉得老师不教重点，孩子一定会吃亏。我也担心自己教得不够好。后来，我改用影片和老照片当教材，再利用网路工具让学生几个人一起找资料，讨论社会上发生的事。现在学生不但记得住内容，还会主动问「为什么」。上个学期，一位家长来学校告诉我，孩子回家会跟他讨论新闻，他这才安心了。

Xuéshēng shàngkè shí yìzhí xiě bǐjì, huíjiā zài jì dá'àn, kěshì kǎo wán méi duō jiǔ jiù wàngjì le. Zhèyàng de xuéxí fāngshì, duì tāmen de wèilái sìhū méiyǒu shénme bāngzhù. Sān nián qián, kǎoshì de zhìdù gǎi le, tímù bú zài zhǐ kǎo jìde duōshǎo, ér shì yào xuéshēng kàn le zīliào yǐhòu, shuō chū zìjǐ de kànfǎ. Gāng kāishǐ, bù shǎo jiāzhǎng hěn bùmǎn, juéde lǎoshī bù jiāo zhòngdiǎn, háizi yídìng huì chīkuī. Wǒ yě dānxīn zìjǐ jiāo de bú gòu hǎo. Hòulái, wǒ gǎi yòng yǐngpiàn hé lǎo zhàopiàn dāng jiàocái, zài lìyòng wǎnglù gōngjù ràng xuéshēng jǐ ge rén yìqǐ zhǎo zīliào, tǎolùn shèhuì shàng fāshēng de shì. Xiànzài xuéshēng búdàn jì de zhù nèiróng, hái huì zhǔdòng wèn "wèishénme". Shàng ge xuéqí, yí wèi jiāzhǎng lái xuéxiào gàosu wǒ, háizi huíjiā huì gēn tā tǎolùn xīnwén, tā zhè cái ānxīn le.
text.english: I have taught history at a high school for fifteen years. My teaching used to centre on getting students to memorise dates and names, because that was what the entrance exams tested. Students took notes all through class and memorised answers at home, but forgot them soon after the exam. Learning like that seemed to do little for their future. Three years ago the exam system changed: questions no longer test only how much you remember, but ask students to give their own view after reading sources. At first many parents were unhappy; they felt teachers were not teaching the key points and their children would lose out. I also worried that I would not teach it well enough. Later I started using videos and old photos as teaching materials, and online tools to have students find sources together in small groups and discuss what is happening in society. Now students not only remember the content but also ask "why" on their own. Last term a parent came to the school and told me their child now discusses the news at home, and only then did they feel at ease.

text.traditional: 最近一份調查發現，臺灣有三分之二的國中生下課以後還得去補習班，在戶外活動的時間一天不到半個小時。我鄰居的兒子小安也是這樣。他從國小就開始補習，一個星期去五天，常常到晚上十點才回家。我常想，換成是我，怎麼受得了？去年暑假，他的父母讓他嘗試參加爬山活動。小安本來很怕高，第一次爬到一半就不肯再走了。可是在大家的加油聲中，他總算克服了這個障礙，爬到了最高的地方。從那次以後，他變得比以前開朗，身心都健康多了。父母認為，既然孩子在山上學到的東西是課本裡學不到的，就把補習減少到一個星期兩天，讓他週末去爬山。現在，連他們自己也常常跟著一起去。

text.pinyin: Zuìjìn yí fèn diàochá fāxiàn, Táiwān yǒu sān fēn zhī èr de guózhōngshēng xiàkè yǐhòu hái děi qù bǔxíbān, zài hùwài huódòng de shíjiān yì tiān bú dào bàn ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ línjū de érzi Xiǎo Ān yě shì zhèyàng. Tā cóng guóxiǎo jiù kāishǐ bǔxí, yí ge xīngqí qù wǔ tiān, chángcháng dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn cái huíjiā. Wǒ cháng xiǎng, huàn chéng shì wǒ, zěnme shòudeliǎo? Qùnián shǔjià, tā de fùmǔ ràng tā chángshì cānjiā páshān huódòng. Xiǎo Ān běnlái hěn pà gāo, dì yī cì pá dào yíbàn jiù bù kěn zài zǒu le. Kěshì zài dàjiā de jiāyóu shēng zhōng, tā zǒngsuàn kèfú le zhège zhàng'ài, pá dào le zuì gāo de dìfāng. Cóng nà cì yǐhòu, tā biàn de bǐ yǐqián kāilǎng, shēnxīn dōu jiànkāng duō le. Fùmǔ rènwéi, jìrán háizi zài shān shàng xué dào de dōngxi shì kèběn lǐ xué bú dào de, jiù bǎ bǔxí jiǎnshǎo dào yí ge xīngqí liǎng tiān, ràng tā zhōumò qù páshān. Xiànzài, lián tāmen zìjǐ yě chángcháng gēnzhe yìqǐ qù.
text.english: A recent survey found that two thirds of Taiwan's junior high students still have to go to cram school after class, and spend less than half an hour a day outdoors. My neighbour's son, Xiao'an, is one of them. He has been at cram school since primary school, five days a week, often not getting home until ten at night. I often think: if it were me, how could I stand it? Last summer his parents let him try a hiking trip. Xiao'an used to be afraid of heights, and on his first climb he refused to go on halfway up. But amid everyone's cheering he finally got over it and climbed to the very top. Since then he has become more cheerful than before, and much healthier in body and mind. His parents decided that, since what the boy learns on the mountain cannot be learned from textbooks, they would cut cram school to two days a week and let him hike at weekends. Now even they often go along.

text.traditional: 我在一所國小教書。以前學校教導孩子地震時應該怎麼做，都是讓他們聽老師說明。結果有一次半夜發生地震，一個學生醒過來以後，嚇得只會在床上哭。從那次以後，學校改了方法，以實際練習代替說明：學校會在上課時突然廣播「地震了」，孩子們得馬上到桌子底下，用手保護頭，等地震停了，再以最快的速度到操場集合。第一次練習時，我以為孩子們會把它看成遊戲，沒想到大家都非常認真，有的孩子甚至記得先把教室的門打開。一連練習了三個月，孩子們都知道萬一發生地震，第一件事應該做什麼。家長都說，這是學校最有用的教學成果。
text.simplified: 我在一所国小教书。以前学校教导孩子地震时应该怎么做，都是让他们听老师说明。结果有一次半夜发生地震，一个学生醒过来以后，吓得只会在床上哭。从那次以后，学校改了方法，以实际练习代替说明：学校会在上课时突然广播「地震了」，孩子们得马上到桌子底下，用手保护头，等地震停了，再以最快的速度到操场集合。第一次练习时，我以为孩子们会把它看成游戏，没想到大家都非常认真，有的孩子甚至记得先把教室的门打开。一连练习了三个月，孩子们都知道万一发生地震，第一件事应该做什么。家长都说，这是学校最有用的教学成果。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài yì suǒ guóxiǎo jiāoshū. Yǐqián xuéxiào jiàodǎo háizi dìzhèn shí yīnggāi zěnme zuò, dōu shì ràng tāmen tīng lǎoshī shuōmíng. Jiéguǒ yǒu yí cì bànyè fāshēng dìzhèn, yí ge xuéshēng xǐng guòlái yǐhòu, xià de zhǐ huì zài chuáng shàng kū. Cóng nà cì yǐhòu, xuéxiào gǎi le fāngfǎ, yǐ shíjì liànxí dàitì shuōmíng: xuéxiào huì zài shàngkè shí túrán guǎngbò "dìzhèn le", háizimen děi mǎshàng dào zhuōzi dǐxià, yòng shǒu bǎohù tóu, děng dìzhèn tíng le, zài yǐ zuì kuài de sùdù dào cāochǎng jíhé. Dì yī cì liànxí shí, wǒ yǐwéi háizimen huì bǎ tā kàn chéng yóuxì, méixiǎngdào dàjiā dōu fēicháng rènzhēn, yǒu de háizi shènzhì jìde xiān bǎ jiàoshì de mén dǎkāi. Yìlián liànxí le sān ge yuè, háizimen dōu zhīdào wànyī fāshēng dìzhèn, dì yī jiàn shì yīnggāi zuò shénme. Jiāzhǎng dōu shuō, zhè shì xuéxiào zuì yǒuyòng de jiàoxué chéngguǒ.
text.english: I am a teacher at a primary school. The school used to teach children what to do in an earthquake by having them listen to a teacher explain it. Then one night an earthquake struck, and a pupil who woke up was so scared he could only cry in bed. Since then the school has changed its method, using real practice instead of explanation: during class the school suddenly announces "Earthquake!" over the speakers, the children must get under their desks at once and cover their heads, and when the shaking stops they gather on the sports ground as fast as they can. At the first practice I thought the children would treat it as a game, but to my surprise they were all very serious, and some even remembered to open the classroom door first. After three months of practice in a row, the children all know the first thing to do if an earthquake ever comes. The parents say it is the most useful result of the school's teaching.
